criteria.statement: The operator guide documents one signer-first create or update, deploy, automatic internal DNS, route-attach, approval, and health-verification flow for Astillero and equivalent Bahia-managed HTTP services.
The guide provides validation-compatible dnsmasq and Cloudflare Tunnel configuration using placeholder SecretRef UUIDs and states that SIGHUP reload reconstructs the whole application.
A healthy deployed service in edge-01-production projects an A or CNAME record in sharegap.net through the DNS reconciler.
Route attachment to an existing deployed service produces a route-only intent whose signed desired-state hash includes the route and preserves the deployed artifact.
Route-only execution succeeds through the routing lifecycle, and routing failure reports compensated restoration without artifact convergence.
DNS override names representing the zone apex as either @ or the zone name resolve to the apex without a duplicated suffix.
The documented workflow forbids direct SQL, manual runtime or proxy edits, manual Cloudflare dashboard changes, and real credential material; the final URL uses HTTPS without a port.
A versioned optional internal HTTPS stanza is validated and covered by the signed desired-state hash, and planner auto-population obeys configured zones plus explicit opt-out.

The nginx backend atomically manages one ownership-marked vhost per hostname, rejects foreign-file collisions, checks certificate and key readability at health or apply time, and restores the prior file and running configuration after test or reload failure.
A plan without an internal HTTPS stanza removes an existing Bahia-owned vhost and reloads nginx so restoration of an older plan converges file state.
Composite routing applies Cloudflare before nginx and compensates nginx then Cloudflare when internal application fails.

The internal_routing configuration defaults commands and file prefix, validates provider, paths, commands, and zone allowlist without reading certificate contents during parse, and is documented with the edge-01 Astillero LAN exemplar.

For astillero.sharegap.net, Bahia centrally converges an authoritative remote-agent dnsmasq include containing both local=/sharegap.net/ and the projected A record, while the same signed desired state carries Cloudflare and InternalHTTPS route outputs, writes the owned nginx vhost through the composite, and hashes both route outputs.
Operator documentation enables and verifies each Bahia-owned guard before removing its hand-applied predecessor, and provides independent rollback steps for authoritative DNS and internal HTTPS.
